ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Заражаться» (zarazhat'sya, 'to be infected') is kept as Tolstoy's central image for the working of art, «совершенствование» (sovershenstvovanie) is 'perfecting', and «развращенный» (razvrashchenny) is 'depraved'. «Магометанские» (magometanskie) is 'Muslim'; the source's «христианское» (khristianskoe) in reading 6 is read as the plural «христианские» (khristianskie, 'Christian').

Source observation: [18] «все христианское и магометанские учители»: «христианское» (singular neuter) is evidently a slip for «христианские» ('Christian', plural); translated as 'all the Christian and Muslim teachers'.

Source observation: [18] The question «лишиться ли всего того, что теперь считается искусством, вместе с ложным, и всего хорошего, которое есть теперь» has no second alternative after «ли» (li, 'whether'); the sentence is translated as printed.
